**CORE SPECIES / ROADSIDE HABITAT / ESTABLISHED HOME IDENTITIES**

target_blocks.text:
AUTHORITY BOUNDARY
Ecology supplies subsidiary bodily and perceptual influence for already-authorized MEDIAN identities. It does not independently create mechanics, register behavior, cultural canon, or cross-system requirements.

<!--@3¶1-->
Every ecological idea entering MEDIAN should be tagged by how it is being used. This prevents evocative extrapolation from hardening into false natural-history claims and protects the game from becoming captive to realism that does not serve play.

| Ecological influence | A broad, credible behavioral or habitat tendency used as inspiration.                              | May illuminate an already-authorized species or Home identity when stated qualitatively.         |

| Design inference     | A possible gameplay conclusion drawn from ecological tendencies.                                   | Has no authority here; omit unless independently authorized by another source or human ruling.    |

| Cultural elaboration | A fictional institution or architecture associated with a bodily tendency.                         | May explain an already-established MEDIAN culture but may not establish one.                      |

| Gameplay convention  | A representational rule that departs from literal visibility or physical behavior for playability. | May be retained only where the convention is independently established.                           |

| Unverified claim     | A precise number, absolute statement, or confident explanation not independently sourced.          | Exclude from authoritative extraction; it may remain research material outside this source.       |

APPLICATION BOUNDARY
Ecology may illuminate or qualify an already-authorized game identity. It does not independently authorize mechanics, register behavior, cultural canon, or new system requirements. Gameplay visibility and established species fantasy remain sovereign.

target_blocks.parent_heading: # 2\. Shared Ecology of Highway Medians and Roadside Fragments
target_blocks.text:
<!--@4¶1-->
Roadside fragments are paradoxical landscapes. The carriageway is a powerful barrier and mortality source, yet the verge and median may contain dense grasses, seed traps, flowering weeds, drainage water, discarded material, reduced human foot traffic, and structures that function as shelter or route anchors. The same edge can be rich, polluted, concealed, noisy, unstable, and lethal.
| Median interior             | Relative continuity, familiar paths, defensible domestic space. | Finite area, resource limits, flood or maintenance exposure. |
| Vegetated margin            | Flowers, seeds, insects, bramble, litter catches, concealment.   | Mowing, runoff, predators, traffic turbulence, human access. |
| Shoulder and curb           | Salvage, food debris, strong edges, drainage structures.         | Vehicle proximity, contamination, sudden disturbance.       |
| Carriageway                 | Possible access to another habitat island.                       | Broad exposure, noise, vibration, speed, and mortality.      |
| Overhead / built structures | Poles, rails, signs, wires, walls, girders, and pipes.            | Wind, maintenance, electrical or human disturbance.         |

EDGE-EFFECT DOCTRINE
The road edge should never be only a hazard boundary. It is the place where danger, forage, salvage, cover, signal, runoff, and human infrastructure become inseparable.

<!--@3.2¶1-->
MEDIAN animals do not divide the world into natural and artificial features. They read material by affordance. A culvert may be a flood channel, refuge, road, border, and foundation. A guardrail may be wall, tactile run, shade line, perch chain, or social boundary depending on the observer.

<!--@3.3¶1-->
The continuous highway hum functions like weather: always present, broadly adapted to, and rarely meaningful by itself. Sudden discontinuities - horn blast, tire failure, impact, mower start, machinery vibration, or abrupt silence - may become salient environmental signals. This observation does not prescribe Watchkeeper, MEET, or other system behavior.

## Extraction contract

Separate claims only when each remains independently grounded and self-contained. Exact spans uniquely ground core assertions. Preserve coordinated subjects or effects in one atom when they share a predicate, subject, condition, or relationship
unless every split has a contiguous span containing its own subject and predicate. A subject or label alone never grounds an
imported predicate. Start each normalized claim with `exact_source_text`. For self-containment,
resolve pronouns and subjectless exact-text prefixes to explicit governing subjects; parent headings
may supply only necessary status or scope.
Never paraphrase, gloss, define, compare, infer, or complete implied meaning;
use `review_required` when necessary. Parent headings are context, never atoms. Every
`exact_source_text` is
a byte-for-byte contiguous target-block substring that occurs exactly once. After JSON decoding it contains actual target-block
characters, never literal backslash Unicode-escape spellings.
Expand repeated or nested terms with adjacent text until unique.
Include interrupting markup or split the atom.

Obey `required_disposition`, `allowed_dispositions`, and `minimum_atoms`;
`no_substantive_claim` requires empty `atoms`. Structural headings, labels, table headers,
delimiters, and document-control metadata carry no substantive atom. List-item
claims may use minimum explicit subject/status/scope/condition/connective from
indivisible-adjacent lead-in/heading for self-containment; never infer/import
unrelated/external meaning or predicates.

For each substantive table row, cover every nonempty semantic cell. Separate
independent properties, functions, effects, examples, interpretations, stages,
actions, and results. Combine cells only when one qualifies
another or the relationship is indivisible. Preserve both endpoints of
categorical mappings.
Ground each headed cell under its header; never infer a relationship between
adjacent cells. No exact span crosses a semicolon; each side gets its own atom.
Copy every authored slash into the normalized claim; never replace it with a word unless the source defines that meaning.
Each independent table-cell assertion requires exact source text from its own
cell; never ground a ruling or consequence only in another cell.

Preserve provisional, historical, rejected, example, negative, conditional,
scope, ownership, and authority qualifiers. Use `review_required` instead of
guessing. Never repair source text or invent identifiers, statuses, owners, or
authorities.

Return schema-bound JSON only after verifying exactly
`required_target_disposition_count` dispositions. Kind `atoms` requires nonempty
`atoms`; all other kinds require empty `atoms`. Every atom needs supplied source/target block IDs, an
allowed stream, exact source text, concise normalized claim, and source-faithful
claim kind. Derive each proposal ID from target block ID plus local atom ordinal;
proposal IDs must remain source-unique.
